skills.detail: A long-range attack with a Knockback effect and a chance to inflict Capture Block. Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
skills.name: Rapid Gunfire

skills.detail:
Begin charging by holding down the skill button.
If you let go of the skill button before the charge has completed, the charge will cancel and you will attack normally. The charge has two stages, and when it has finished, you will unleash a different attack.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.

Not Charged: A long-range attack with a Knockback effect.

Charged: An extra long-range multiple hit attack with a Knockback effect and a chance to inflict Capture Block.

Double Charged: Increases own ATK. An extra long-range multiple hit attack with a Knockback effect and a chance to inflict Capture Block. Damage dealt will disregard damage reduction.
